name: United Company RUSAL, International Public Joint-Stock Company
summary: United Company RUSAL, International Public Joint-Stock Company engages in the production of aluminum in Russia. It operates through four segments: Aluminium, Alumina, Energy, and Mining and Metals. The company offers primary aluminum, cylindrical and flat ingots, aluminum and primary casting alloys, rods, high purity aluminum, foil and packaging, aluminum wheels, alumina and bauxite, corundum, gallium, silicon, aluminum alloy protectors, and micro silica. It also provides quartzites, bischofite, ligature, equipment, and SOP products.
